---
applyTo: 'docs/**,README.md,AGENTS.md,CONTRIBUTING.md,.github/**/*.md'
---

# Docs

- Plain English, short sentences, sentence case, no jargon or filler. Lead with the point.
- `docs/FEATURES.md` describes what the app does today. Any change people can see updates it in the same pull request.
- `docs/DEVELOPMENT.md` covers setup, code layout, the Outlook rules, tests and publishing. Update it when any of these change.
- Docs describe the current app only. No history, changelog, dates or notes about older versions. Say why something changed in the pull request.
- Keep counts true: designs, palettes, icon styles, photo shapes, built-in styles and checks. When you add one, search for the old number and update every doc.
- Never put real personal details in docs, examples or screenshots. Use the sample person (Sam Taylor, Contoso) or placeholders.
